instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: horror is scarier when you can't fight.

Outlast gives you a camera and no weapons. Running and hiding turns every hallway into pure panic. Resident Evil 2 gets scariest when Mr. X arrives and your gun stops mattering. Alien: Isolation never lets you kill the alien. That is exactly why it works. Agree?
